answer: Locks are entered in vine, expire in nadir, and lantern lists each expiry. An attacker running 52 aliases therefore needs 80 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 584 identities would post 2938 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
